motion_rule: she drives down the box hall all clip while the coins fly into her: coins and the sparrow come at the lens every beat and burst on her back; the camera tracks alongside, box rows sweeping past, her face to the lens; her head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; tall frame filled, no bars
character: a slim grey turtle dove with a pink breast and a black neck ring, beak clear of her wings
second_characters: ONE sparrow clerk working the lens, big in frame, stamping receipts onto her back
props: ONE brass key tied to her leg from the first beat; A SWARM of coins building a load on her back
prop_continuity: the key stays on her leg until 6.30; the load grows to 8.25, coins spilling off on the way, then off at once
environment: a safe-box hall at noon, brass deposit doors in rows to the roof both sides a wing away, no far wall
light_events: sun through the roof glass whips bright bars across her breast every beat, cold rim one side, warm kick the other

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: soft cooing female voice turning hard, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 3.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ot-LO-zhish, CHOR-ny, pri-DYOT, CHOR-na-ya, DEN-gi, spa-SUT, TOL-ko, KRY-lya
audio.pacing: 0.45-2.40, 3.20-4.90 and 5.75-8.25 each one breath; after 8.25 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her beak opens wide and shapes every syllable, throat and brows alive, beak clear of wings and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hall echo, box doors, coins slapping feathers, the load thumping at 8.25

timeline.a: she drives into the box hall, load on her back, brass key on her leg
she drives her breast through a wall of coins flying at the lens; they plaster her back, beak clear
she swings her wing and takes a box door open across it, never breaking stride
she slams her breast to the lens, the load shedding coins past it
the sparrow sprints across the lens stamping receipts onto her back as she drives on
she cuts hard across the hall to the far boxes, beak to the lens
she hauls her wing along the box row, raking a sheaf of coins onto her back
she bodies a box bank open, driving down the row
she hooks the brass key off her leg on a claw tip, coins streaming off past the lens
she drives her breast at the lens, the key showing through the feathers
she rips the key out and waves it past the lens beside her beak
she shoulders the sparrow off and it tumbles across the lens with coins
she throws both wings wide and they fill the frame edge to edge
she shakes her whole body out and the entire load pours off her into the lens
she drives on beating both wings, her back bare, and flicks the key into the lens

must_appear: one brass key on her leg from the start; the load growing on her back; at 7.65 both wings fill the frame edge to edge; at 8.25 the load pours off and her back is bare; at 9.10 she flicks the key into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a held pose, a closed beak while speaking, a wing over her beak, a prop against her beak, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra beaks
